mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotion (name, type, rule_type, target_group, scope_type, tag_name, start_time, end_time, manual_status, is_deleted, create_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{type}, #{ruleType}, #{targetGroup}, #{scopeType}, #{tagName}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, 0, 0, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE promotion SET name = #{name}, type = #{type}, rule_type = #{ruleType}, target_group = #{targetGroup}, scope_type = #{scopeType}, tag_name = #{tagName}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
